messages:
maria: Originate RC: pinned artifact abc123 -> rc/v1.4.2-rc1. No DB migrations. Target promo window 10:30-11:00 PT. Please +1 or flag issues. Release notes -> https://internal.redwood/release/rc-v1.4.2-rc1 :eyes:
alex: Quick question - is kv-warm required for this RC?
jun: @maria if we do warm, keep to 15m pre-promo. Not strictly required for this change but recommended for embed service.
sara: Posted release-notes snippet and changelog in docs: https://docs.redwood/releases/v1.4.2-rc1 — small LLM model bump + logging tweak.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] rc created: rc/v1.4.2-rc1 pinned to docker:model-server:abc123. To promote: `/deploy promote rc/v1.4.2-rc1 --to prod --canary 5,50,100 --step-duration 10m`
paul: Running quick smoke now on staging (sanity + perf). Will post results.
alex: kicked off smoke tests: `/smoke run rc/v1.4.2-rc1 --suite quick`
deploy-bot: smoke results: 12/12 tests passed. median latency 82ms, p95 210ms, 0 failed requests. No auth regressions recorded.
jun: Ops +1 on smoke. Suggest keeping 5% canary for 15m instead of 10m since we touched routing logic.
paul: noted. Also adding watchlist: prod-5xx-rate, prod-tail-latency-99, embed-miss-rate.
maria: Good call. Audit-log and metrics dash are ready. Promo will include staged canary 5%->50%->100% with manual hold between steps.
paul: Rolling rollback snippet here for quick revert:
```
# rollback to previous stable
/deploy promote rc/v1.4.1 --to prod --immediate
# or k8s quick image set
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/model-server model-server=redwood/model-server:stable
```
paul: If anything >0.5% 5xx or p99 increases >200ms, abort and run rollback.
sara: Confirming release notes published and customer-facing blurb is queued for docs site.
maria: Promo on my go. I'll trigger within the change window. If you see anything off, call the sheriff.
deploy-bot: Promotion queued by maria. Starting canary 5% now. Expected step durations: 15m, 10m, 10m.
ops-bot: Will apply KV warm for embed cache now (15m). Monitoring hooks set: prod-latency-spike, model-5xx-rate. Pager thresholds configured.
paul: 5% canary metrics look normal at +5m. No errors, latency flat.
paul: at +12m p95 jumped to 320ms on one shard, digging.
jun: Hold rollout. pausing canary. Investigating logs.
paul: Found cause: one older GPU node had driver GC spikes — removing from pool fixed temp spike. Rolling forward resume on hold cleared.
maria: resuming canary to 50% after verification.
deploy-bot: Canary step to 50% started.
paul: 50% steady for 8m, no regressions.
maria: promote to 100% now.
deploy-bot: Promotion to 100% in progress. Finalizing traffic shift.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete: rc/v1.4.2-rc1 -> prod. Post-deploy smoke run starting.
deploy-bot: Post-deploy smoke passed. All checks green.
maria: Thanks team — RC promoted. Notes: rollback command stored in runbook, watch alerts for next 2 hours. :tada:
